tests.name: src/db/__tests__/index-state.test.ts: completenessOf table test, undefined state, reason lines, recount on open corrects a hand-edited count, unregistered repoId row deleted, aborted transaction leaves counts

cases.title: completenessOf table test: graphComplete and complete follow the sc1 formula for every combination of the inputs, and reasons are empty exactly when complete
completenessOf(undefined) reads not complete with "a reindex is needed"
completeness reason lines: one per non-zero cause with its count, awaiting rows split by reason, no-candidate and ambiguous rows not a cause
an aborted transaction leaves the counts unchanged: a callback that writes a pending row and its count, then throws, leaves neither
recount on open corrects a hand-edited count with a warn log, and deletes the row of an unregistered repoId
